This is a classic reverse-shell / TTY upgrade pattern: a Python one-liner spawning an interactive bash shell as root, with no legitimate administrative context visible. The process chain (python3 with -c, then bash with a pts1 tty allocated, parent PID 17398) is characteristic of an attacker who has gained command execution and is stabilizing an interactive shell.
